## Football effect

Bouye finished the game: the record logs the injury at the end of Jacksonville's second possession at 6:50 of the first quarter with no removal, and he played the second-quarter substitution possession beside the veteran safeties (two tackles, the third-and-6 stop with Daryl Smith), the two-minute possession (the tackle on Hester's third-and-10 conversion), every second-half possession with the reserves and the kicking game (the tackle on Hester's 32-yard kickoff return). The instruction after the game is out, and on the projection he misses the August 29 review and is reassessed that day; the August 31 projected return precedes the Week 1 preparation. The reserve-corner place remains unfilled and is not decided by the instruction. No role change follows and no football finding attaches to it.
